title: Forearm Training: Chuck Sipes (1971)
author: Mithosphere
desc: Run as a 3-day program, such as Monday/Wednesday/Friday in conjunction with normal training.

ex.note: Warm-up: 1x20, then add 10 lbs each set for max reps.
Loaded so you can only roll 2/3 of the way up. When you get all the way up, add weight.
Use heavy enough weight so you have to "cheat" by using body motion to wrist curl the bar.
